statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2025-0057 is an informational notice that the fxhash crate is unmaintained and identifies no patched release. Milvus 2.6.23 includes it transitively through jieba-rs in its embedded Tantivy binding; migrating to rustc-hash requires an upstream jieba-rs dependency migration and remains under evaluation. See https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2025-0057.html

RUSTSEC-2025-0057 is an informational notice that the fxhash crate is unmaintained and identifies no patched release. Milvus 2.6.23 includes it transitively through jieba-rs in its embedded Tantivy binding; migrating to rustc-hash requires an upstream jieba-rs dependency migration and remains under evaluation. See https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2025-0057.html

RUSTSEC-2025-0057 reports that fxhash is unmaintained with no active development or security fixes. The qdrant binary uses fxhash as a fast non-cryptographic hash function for internal data structures. While no specific vulnerability is identified, the lack of maintenance poses a long-term risk. Investigation is ongoing to assess migration to maintained alternatives such as rustc-hash or ahash, but this requires upstream qdrant changes.
